# Mod profiles resolved against the OAMOD registry: the registry's tables
# (generated by tools/gen_mod_registry.py from registry/hack-registry.yaml),
# the resolver, the canonical form and hashes, and the records the engine
# reads. It takes bytes and plain values and never opens a file.
add_library(oa-data-mod-profile src/baseline.cpp src/overrides.cpp src/records.cpp src/registry.cpp src/resolver.cpp
  src/value.cpp)
add_library(oa::data::mod_profile ALIAS oa-data-mod-profile)
target_include_directories(oa-data-mod-profile PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(oa-data-mod-profile PUBLIC oa-formats-oamod oa-data-limits oa-data-match-rules oa-base-sha256
  PRIVATE oa-options)
target_compile_features(oa-data-mod-profile PUBLIC cxx_std_20)

if(BUILD_TESTING)
  # The resolver's cases: blocks, presets, shorthand, settings, match options,
  # every refusal, the canonical form and hashes.
  add_executable(oa-data-mod-profile-test tests/mod_profile_test.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(oa-data-mod-profile-test PRIVATE oa-data-mod-profile oa-platform-shims oa-test-support
    oa-options)
  add_test(NAME data-mod-profile COMMAND oa-data-mod-profile-test)
  # Every registry parameter is bound to exactly one record field that can
  # hold it, whose default is the parameter's baseline; the registry's own
  # values all pass the resolver's checks.
  add_executable(oa-data-mod-profile-bindings-test tests/bindings_test.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(oa-data-mod-profile-bindings-test PRIVATE oa-data-mod-profile oa-test-support
    oa-options)
  add_test(NAME data-mod-profile-bindings COMMAND oa-data-mod-profile-bindings-test)
  # The reference profiles in the folder OA_MOD_PROFILES_DIR names resolve to
  # their pinned hashes; skipped without it.
  add_test(NAME data-mod-profile-references COMMAND oa-data-mod-profile-test --references)
  set_tests_properties(data-mod-profile-references PROPERTIES SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77)
  if(DEFINED OA_MOD_PROFILES_DIR)
    set_tests_properties(data-mod-profile-references PROPERTIES
      ENVIRONMENT "OA_MOD_PROFILES_DIR=${OA_MOD_PROFILES_DIR}")
  endif()
endif()
